The '''Battle of Kashoon''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It began with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] invading the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashoon]]. The native [[Kashoonara]] rebelled and were brutally suppressed, until the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was able to drive the Empire from the planet through a series of guerrilla assaults. Control of the planet was then returned to the Kashoonara, and the Alliance left the world.
